decisions.reason: It has remained prominently marketed since launch and sits very close to the firm’s core airport-operations software offer, so its observed performance likely meets aspiration levels and justifies continued support.

Its move from a website mention to a dedicated page suggests improving acceptance and, as a connectivity module for apron operations, it fits the firm’s strategy of deeper digital integration across the airport.

Although billing software is somewhat less central than safety and operational control tools, its upgraded market presentation and adjacency to the installed software base make it more likely to be retained than dropped.
Equipment monitoring leverages the firm’s strong installed-base and maintenance capabilities, and its increased website prominence indicates performance likely above the threshold for continuation.
